remarks: Introducing the MONOCO LUXURY HOME by CUSTOM BUILDER Happy Planet Homes. OPEN TO BELOW, 3 BED PLUS DEN. 3 BATH! The open concept Kitchen dazzles with premium finishes, including walkthrough pantry, quartz countertops and modern open shelves in the dining area. The Custom fireplace feature wall truly highlights the grand scale of the open to below the living room. Climb up stairs to discover the large bonus room connecting the upper floor. The family oriented design flaunts 2 bedrooms, enclosed laundry room, an additional 4 pc bath room and the Primary suite overlooking greenspace. The large primary bedroom displays a stunning tray ceiling, large walk-in closet and a spa retreat in the modern 5 pc ensuite. Every detail is carefully planned and designed to be functional and elevated, from integrated built-ins, to the tile backsplashes, soft close cabinetry and more. UNDER CONSTRUCTION!  Photos example of floorplan and potential finishes. Actual build may vary. (id:67522)
